ConfluenceOnNewContentConfig.description:
Poll-based trigger: fire when new pages/blogposts/comments are created.

Confluence has no general inbound webhook for REST/Basic-auth clients, so we
poll the v1 CQL search (``type IN (page, blogpost, comment) order by created
desc``) on a schedule and emit only content created since the last poll,
deduped on the most-recent content id.

space_id.description: Only watch a single space (optional; watches all spaces if blank)
space_id.title: Space

x-dynamic-options.custom_placeholder: Or type a numeric space ID

content_type.description: Which kind of newly-created content to watch
content_type.title: Content Type

schedule.description: How often to check for new content
schedule.title: Check Frequency

max_results.description: Maximum number of new items to fetch per check (1-100)
max_results.title: Max Items

ConfluenceOnNewContentConfig.title: ConfluenceOnNewContentConfig
